test_load_audio: test loading audio from a WAV file into a numpy array using spdl.io.load_audio
test_batch_audio_conversion: test batch converting audio frames from multiple timestamps using spdl.io.convert_frames
run_load_audio: run spdl.io.load_audio to load an audio file with a given filter description into a buffer
run_demux_audio: run spdl.io.Demuxer to demux audio packets from a file at specific time ranges
run_decode_packets: run spdl.io.decode_packets to decode demuxed audio packets into frames with a filter description
